title: Cereceda's Conjecture
exact_target: For each fixed degeneracy, can any two proper colorings using two extra colors be joined by a polynomial-length sequence of valid single-vertex recolorings?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1395 (GRAPH-008). CC BY 4.0.
Nicolas Bousquet and Marc Heinrich, \emph{A polynomial version of Cereceda's conjecture}, Journal of Combinatorial Theory, Series B 155 (2022); arXiv:1903.05619v1, abstract and Section 1.
